title: Neon workspace
selectConnection: Select a Neon connection to continue.
noConnection: Open a saved Neon connection in the sidebar, then reopen this workspace to manage its services and credentials.
waiting: Waiting for a live snapshot… This can take up to 30 seconds.
overviewDescription: Services and connection details for this branch.
branchesHint: Requires the optional NEON_PROJECT_ID and NEON_API_KEY credentials. Branches are read-only here.
databaseDescription: Latest demo notes in this project.
storageDescription: Browse objects in the assets bucket.
deleteObjectConfirm: Permanently delete “{{key}}” from the assets bucket?
putObjectConfirm: Save “{{key}}” to the assets bucket? Existing content at this key will be replaced.
aiDescription: Choose an enabled model and try a prompt.
noModels: No enabled models returned. Check AI Gateway configuration in the Neon console.
aiCost: Uses AI Gateway credits. Response limited to 64 tokens.
functionsDescription: Call the configured hello function and inspect its response.
realtimeDescription: Read a live SQL snapshot or wait for a matching value.
realtimeHint: A single snapshot is returned within 30 seconds, then the subscription closes. For a target value, change a matching row in another SQL editor while this request waits.
snapshotComplete: Snapshot received. The subscription is now closed.
setupDescription: Store service access for this connection. Saved values remain hidden.
setupHint: Development .env files are not loaded automatically in Tabularis. Import the complete service credential bundle for this connection. Saving replaces all previously imported fields; omitted fields are removed.
noCredentials: No service credentials stored for this connection.
importLabel: Import .env lines or a JSON object
importPlaceholder: Paste credentials here. Values stay masked.
deleteCredentialsConfirm: Remove all imported service credentials for this connection from the keyring? You will need to import them again to use these services.
credentialsSaved: Credentials saved. The pasted draft has been cleared.
fieldsHint: SQL access comes from the saved Tabularis connection. Import matching branch credentials. NEON_PROJECT_ID and NEON_API_KEY are optional and only needed for project branch listing.

credentialErrors.empty: Paste at least one supported credential.
credentialErrors.syntax: Use KEY=value lines or a valid JSON object with string values.
credentialErrors.unsupported: The input contains an unsupported field. Check the supported credential names below.
credentialErrors.value: Each credential must contain a non-empty text value.
credentialErrors.duplicate: A credential appears more than once. Keep one value for each field.

coreRequired: This workspace requires the current Tabularis provider-workspace build.
storageEmpty: List the bucket to browse objects. Use the prefix to narrow the results.
textObjectsHint: Read an existing object or prepare text to save. Writes require confirmation.
aiEmpty: The model response will appear here after you send a prompt.
functionEmpty: Invoke the function to inspect its response.
realtimeEmpty: Run the query to inspect its current live result.
storedFieldsHint: Only field names are shown. Stored values cannot be read back.

account.title: Connect a Neon account
account.description: Connect your Neon account with an API key, then import an existing branch and its enabled services.
account.keyHint: Stored in the host secret store. The saved key cannot be read back by the UI.
account.createKey: Create an API key in Neon
account.noProjects: No projects are available in this scope. Select an organization or check the API key permissions.
account.createCredentials: Create scoped credentials for enabled Storage and AI Gateway services
account.credentialsHint: Creates new service credentials on the selected branch. Existing services are discovered without enabling, deploying, rotating, or deleting anything. Without this option, these services may require a later credential import.
account.importedHint: The connection is now available in Connections. Open it to access its Neon services in the explorer.

authManager.description: Inspect users on this connection. Account access is required for management actions.
authManager.accountRequired: Connect a Neon account with permission for this project and branch to manage users. Read-only inspection remains available.
authManager.createHint: Creates an Auth identity using the management API. No password is set here; the user completes authentication or password recovery through your application.
authManager.name: Name
authManager.profileReadOnly: Profile fields are read-only because the management API does not expose profile updates. Roles can be changed below.
authManager.sessionsReadOnly: Session metadata is read-only. Session revocation and password-reset actions require an Auth admin session and are not available through this account API.
authManager.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this user from the selected branch? This can affect application data linked to this identity.

functionsManager.accountRequired: Connect a Neon account and select a project branch to manage Functions.
functionsManager.description: Deployed functions on this branch. Open a function to edit, configure, invoke or inspect it.
functionsManager.empty: No functions have been deployed on this branch.
functionsManager.createDescription: Create a JavaScript function on this branch. Deployment makes its HTTP endpoint available.
functionsManager.editDescription: Manage this function on the selected branch. Refresh to check an asynchronous deployment.
functionsManager.slugHint: 1–20 lowercase letters or digits. The slug becomes part of the URL and cannot be renamed.
functionsManager.sourceHint: Single-file JavaScript module for Node.js. External packages are not bundled. Put secrets in environment variables rather than source code.
functionsManager.sourceUnavailable: Neon does not return the deployed source. Paste your local source to replace this function; the existing code stays unchanged until you confirm deployment.
functionsManager.sessionDraftHint: Source drafts survive tab switching during this session. Keep a local copy before restarting the app.
functionsManager.replaceWarning: Replace the deployed source of {{slug}} on this branch? The previous code may stop serving while the new deployment starts.
functionsManager.deploymentStarted: Deployment accepted: {{status}}. Refresh to check the current state.
functionsManager.environmentHint: Existing values stay hidden. Submit a JSON object with only changed keys; use null to remove a key. Unmentioned keys remain unchanged.
functionsManager.invalidEnvironment: Enter a JSON object containing valid environment names with non-empty strings or null, up to 64 keys and 24 KiB.
functionsManager.newEnvironmentHint: These changes will be included in the first deployment.
functionsManager.environmentSaved: Environment update accepted. Existing values stay hidden and the input has been cleared.
functionsManager.invokeHint: Send a request to this function's deployed endpoint. Your Neon account key is never forwarded to the function.
functionsManager.logsUnavailable: Logs are not available through the current management API.
functionsManager.deleteWarning: Delete {{slug}} and its deployed endpoint from this branch? This cannot be undone.
functionsManager.activationWarning: Live tests found that endpoints kept serving previous code and environment values after Neon reported an active, completed update. New function creation worked. Verify the endpoint after submitting updates; activation is currently unreliable in this tested environment.

management.missingBinding: Save the Neon project and branch in Connection / Setup before managing services.
management.connectRequired: Connect a Neon account with permission for this project to manage services.
management.branchMissing: The saved branch could not be found in this project.
